description: Land Title Settlement Department - Heraliyawala, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420369
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
